entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically
entries.note: Pre-advice; matched on "electronically".

entries.wording: Die Sendung wurde vom Absender elektronisch angekündigt.
entries.note: German pre-advice; matched on "elektronisch".

entries.wording: Pick-up has been scheduled for the next working day and the information has been sent to the delivery person
entries.note: A booked collection, before "Pick-up was successful.".

entries.wording: Pick-up was successful.
The shipment has been posted by the sender at the retail outlet
entries.note: Deutsche Post's posting at a retail outlet, "in der Filiale eingeliefert" in German.

entries.wording: The shipment was handed over to DHL.
Die Sendung wurde im Briefzentrum bearbeitet.
entries.note: Mail-centre processing scan.

entries.wording: The shipment has been processed in the parcel center
The shipment will be transported to the destination country/destination area and, from there, handed over to the delivery organization.
entries.note: Explicitly transit, never the handover it announces.

entries.wording: The shipment has arrived in the destination country/destination area.
entries.note: Carries the destination operator's link; an exact post.ch host marks a Swiss Post last mile.

entries.wording: The shipment is being processed by customs
The customs clearance process for import into the destination country/region has been completed.
entries.note: Completion leaves customs; the started variant stays in customs.

entries.wording: The shipment has been loaded into the delivery vehicle
Die Sendung wurde in das Zustellfahrzeug geladen.
The shipment is ready for collection
Die Sendung liegt zur Abholung bereit.
The shipment has been delivered
Die Sendung wurde erfolgreich zugestellt.
entries.note: The negated form maps to failed_attempt, not delivery.

entries.wording: The shipment could not be delivered
Die Sendung konnte nicht zugestellt werden.
Die Sendung wurde nicht erfolgreich zugestellt.
entries.note: Negation is matched before the delivery wording.

entries.wording: Delivery not possible. Pickup information will follow by mail
entries.note: After the loading onto the delivery vehicle, before the parcel is ready at a retail outlet; CTT's copy of the scan is its failed delivery.

entries.wording: Delivery not possible. Forwarding in postal retail outlet
entries.note: After the loading onto the delivery vehicle, before the parcel is ready at a retail outlet; PostNord's copy of the scan is its DELIVERY_IMPOSSIBLE.

entries.wording: Die Sendung wurde abgeholt.
entries.note: "Pick-up was successful." in English.

entries.wording: Die Sendung wurde von DHL abgeholt.
entries.note: "The shipment was picked up by DHL." in English.

entries.wording: Die Sendung ist im Zielland/Zielgebiet eingetroffen.
entries.note: The arrival abroad, with the partner's link as in English.

entries.wording: Die Sendung wird für die Verladung ins Zustellfahrzeug vorbereitet.
entries.note: "The shipment has been processed in the delivery base." in English: not yet on the vehicle.

entries.wording: Die Sendung liegt zur Abholung in einem ParcelShop/in der Postfiliale bereit.
entries.note: A parcel waiting abroad; DHL appends where to read more.

entries.wording: The shipment is returning to sender
entries.note: A return under way: the parcel is not back yet, and returned is final.

entries.wording: The recipient has not picked up the shipment from the retail outlet within the seven-day storage period
entries.note: Quoted on https://www.paketda.de/status-dhl-lagerfrist-nicht-abgeholt.html; the parcel goes back to the sender. "Not picked up" is never a pick-up.

entries.wording: Der Empfänger hat die Sendung innerhalb der siebentägigen Lagerfrist nicht in der Filiale abgeholt.
entries.note: The same scan in German, on the same Paketda page.

entries.wording: Die Sendung wurde nicht abgeholt und wird zurückgesandt.
entries.note: Quoted on https://www.paketda.de/status-dhl-sendung-nicht-abgeholt.html: a return to come.

entries.wording: Die Sendung befindet sich auf dem Weg zurück zum Absender.
entries.note: Quoted on https://www.paketda.de/status-dhl-ruecksendung-eingeleitet.html: a return under way.

entries.wording: The shipment will be delivered tomorrow
entries.note: Forecast: deliberately unmapped. It keeps the structured progress fallback rather than announcing delivery or pre-advice.
Structured completion flag; outranks the wording.
A completed return, not a delivery.
